description: Remove ProcessCredentialsProvider and the original ProfileConfigFileAWSCredentialsProvider, which the default chain stopped using once the CRT-backed ProfileCredentialsProvider took over their work. ProfileConfigFileAWSCredentialsProvider still compiles as a deprecated alias of ProfileCredentialsProvider; use ProfileCredentialsProvider for credential_process too. ProfileCredentialsProvider's default constructor picks the profile from AWS_PROFILE, then default; unlike the old provider, it does not read AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE, and an empty AWS_PROFILE is not treated as default, so set it to a profile name or unset it. Unlike the old provider, ProfileCredentialsProvider reads the config and credentials files once when it is created, so keys rotated in the files are picked up only by a new provider. It also follows the shared config file format strictly: a line that starts with whitespace continues the previous property, so a profile line indented by mistake can stop the file from loading. AWSCredentialsProvider.h no longer includes GeneralHTTPCredentialsProvider.h; include it directly to use GeneralHTTPCredentialsProvider or TaskRoleCredentialsProvider.
